summary: Frontend-only wiring test for Melhor Envio SANDBOX (placeholders). All key requirements validated: admin nav, /admin/melhor-envio page state (badge 'sandbox', 'Não configurado', connect btn disabled, config warning), sender card fields all present, save + persistence via reload works. AdminProducts edit modal shows Dados logísticos section with pf-weight/width/height/length/sku/barcode fields, ship-incomplete-alert appears when empty and disappears after all 4 dims > 0, values persist after save+reopen. AdminPedidos toggles show shipment-panel-{order} with 'Pedido sem cotação Melhor Envio (frete padrão)' text. Checkout flow: shipping-card with calc-shipping-btn, addr-document, addr-phone present; calc-shipping did not crash (checkout still functional); a full purchase completed with order #BM326661 confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout.calcShipping only shows toast on error - if backend returns 200 with empty options[], user just sees 'Nenhuma opção de frete disponível' silently, which is fine but could add success/info toast when connected==false to be more explicit ('Melhor Envio não conectado - usando frete padrão').
AdminMelhorEnvio has 'connect_disabled=true' correctly when configured=false; consider surfacing a tooltip on the disabled button explaining WHY it is disabled.
GET /api/products (public) does not expose weight/width/height/length, so client cannot pre-warn shoppers about missing dims; only backend 422 catches it. Acceptable for MVP.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Melhor Envio placeholders behave as expected: connect button disabled, sender persists via PUT/GET. Checkout /shipping/quote returns 422 for products without dims and 503-like friendly errors when ME not connected — both surfaced as toasts by Checkout.js. Regression: /, /produtos, /produto/:id, /admin, /admin/pedidos, /admin/produtos, /admin/melhor-envio all load. Order placement works end-to-end with fallback shipping.
